entries.title: Psalms 50:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> The Mighty One, God the LORD, Has spoken and called the earth From the rising of the sun to its going down.

entries.title: Psalms 50:2
segments: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God will shine forth.

entries.title: Psalms 50:3
segments: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silent; A fire shall devour before Him, And it shall be very tempestuous all around Him.

entries.title: Psalms 50:4
segments: He shall call to the heavens from above, And to the earth, that He may judge His people:

entries.title: Psalms 50:5
segments: "Gather My saints together to Me, Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice."

entries.title: Psalms 50:6
segments: Let the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself [is] Judge. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 50:7
segments: ¶"Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you; I [am] God, your God!

entries.title: Psalms 50:8
segments: I will not rebuke you for your sacrifices Or your burnt offerings, [Which are] continually before Me.

entries.title: Psalms 50:9
segments: I will not take a bull from your house, [Nor] goats out of your folds.

entries.title: Psalms 50:10
segments: For every beast of the forest [is] Mine, [And] the cattle on a thousand hills.

entries.title: Psalms 50:11
segments: I know all the birds of the mountains, And the wild beasts of the field [are] Mine.

entries.title: Psalms 50:12
segments: "If I were hungry, I would not tell you; For the world [is] Mine, and all its fullness.

entries.title: Psalms 50:13
segments: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?

entries.title: Psalms 50:14
segments: Offer to God thanksgiving, And pay your vows to the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 50:15
segments: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me."

entries.title: Psalms 50:16
segments: ¶But to the wicked God says: "What [right] have you to declare My statutes, Or take My covenant in your mouth,

entries.title: Psalms 50:17
segments: Seeing you hate instruction And cast My words behind you?

entries.title: Psalms 50:18
segments: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, And have been a partaker with adulterers.

entries.title: Psalms 50:19
segments: You give your mouth to evil, And your tongue frames deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 50:20
segments: You sit [and] speak against your brother; You slander your own mother's son.

entries.title: Psalms 50:21
segments: These [things] you have done, and I kept silent; You thought that I was altogether like you; [But] I will rebuke you, And set [them] in order before your eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 50:22
segments: "Now consider this, you who forget God, Lest I tear [you] in pieces, And [there be] none to deliver:

entries.title: Psalms 50:23
segments: Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; And to him who orders [his] conduct [aright] I will show the salvation of God."
